deadlines.name: Reading quizzes
deadlines.rule: Five short online multiple-choice quizzes on the readings (10–15 minutes each), one per part of the course. You have a week to take each; due Sept 18, Oct 7, Oct 14, Nov 6 and Dec 4. Your lowest is dropped, so only four count.

deadlines.name: In-class activities
deadlines.rule: Five group worksheets in class (Sept 23, Oct 16, Oct 28, Nov 9, Dec 2). Upload a photo of your work to Canvas within 24 hours. Pass/fail, 5% each; you need four of the five. No copies are sent to people who miss class.

deadlines.name: Exams
deadlines.rule: Three closed-book multiple-choice midterms in class (Sept 30, Oct 21, Nov 16), each on the material since the previous exam; the lowest is dropped. The final (Mon Dec 14) is multiple choice plus short answer and covers the whole semester.

deadlines.name: Late work
deadlines.rule: 50% penalty within 24 hours of the deadline; at most 25% of the points within 48 hours; not accepted after that.

deadlines.name: Attendance
deadlines.rule: Taken with iClicker at the start of class. Missing less than 2 weeks of classes adds 5 points to your grade; 2–3 weeks, no change; more than 3 and up to 4 weeks, minus 5; more than 4 weeks fails the class.

EXAMS.name: Midterm 1
EXAMS.dateLabel: Wed Sept 30, in class (9:00 am, Norm Asbjornson Hall 165)
EXAMS.covers: Parts I and II: basic concepts, history and current challenges, anarchy, realism, liberalism, constructivism and other frameworks
EXAMS.format: Closed-book multiple choice in one class period, on everything since the start of the semester. Your lowest midterm is dropped.

EXAMS.name: Midterm 2
EXAMS.dateLabel: Wed Oct 21, in class (9:00 am, Norm Asbjornson Hall 165)
EXAMS.covers: Part III so far: causes of interstate war (Fearon), civil wars, and weapons of mass destruction (Tannenwald, Waltz)
EXAMS.format: Closed-book multiple choice on the material since Midterm 1. Your lowest midterm is dropped.

EXAMS.name: Midterm 3
EXAMS.dateLabel: Mon Nov 16, in class (9:00 am, Norm Asbjornson Hall 165)
EXAMS.covers: Everything since Midterm 2: the end of weapons of mass destruction, international organizations and the UN Charter, international law and human rights (UDHR, Rwanda), and the first trade class
EXAMS.format: Closed-book multiple choice on the material since Midterm 2. Your lowest midterm is dropped.

EXAMS.name: Final exam
EXAMS.dateLabel: Mon Dec 14 (check the MSU final exam schedule and Canvas for the time and room)
EXAMS.covers: The whole semester, including trade and globalization, monetary relations and financial crises, and environment and population
EXAMS.format: Multiple choice and short answer, cumulative. It counts 30% and cannot be dropped or replaced by a midterm.
